phase: Initial frozen prototype run; next implementation/fix approval pending
status: Distributed gameplay prototype incomplete; no release recommendation

groups.finding: The harness sent endinv new public through RCON. EndInvCommand.createNew unconditionally requires source.getPlayerOrException(); all three real servers returned A player must execute this command. This prevented populated EndInv fixtures.
groups.confidence: high: matching recorded command responses and actual code
groups.recommended_fix: Drive fixture creation as a real authenticated lab player with real EndInv installed; retain existing EndInv command semantics. Exercise populated snapshot and selection/permissions, then rerun smoke and full matrix.

groups.finding: Both candidate workers refused distributed mode at explicit startup guards. Whole-dimension bootstrap isolation, player admission/quiescence/apply recovery and async real-mod transaction adapters remain unimplemented.
groups.confidence: high: source guards and both process logs
groups.recommended_fix: Implement guarded static dimension initialization plus authenticated admission and an owner-queue player apply journal. Bind live node boots/session epochs and validate current ownership before applying replayed acknowledgments. Add actual gameplay scenario drivers; do not remove gates merely to obtain a passing boot.

groups.finding: These cases have explicit BLOCKED records; no gameplay behaviors were simulated or counted as passing. Real EndInv/Inventory/World/Economy escrow and asynchronous mutation routing are absent.
groups.confidence: high for coverage status; no behavioral or consistency confidence for unexecuted paths
groups.recommended_fix: Implement actual command backends, cross-store reservations/commit/reconciliation, source tombstones and single shared scheduler; replace blocked drivers with real-client operation assertions.

groups.finding: No active client generator, headless display setup or pinned permissions stack. 4 CPU cores/16GiB cannot reproduce owner20GB heap. Multi-PC tests remain BLOCKED by explicit user decision.
groups.confidence: high for attached host limits and recorded prerequisites
groups.recommended_fix: Provision disposable local clients for coordination correctness and a complete pinned stack. Keep remote tests blocked for this run; require separate hosts before any multi-PC capacity claim.

groups.finding: All three offline lab servers logged a failed Yggdrasil public-key fetch with connection refused. A post-run HTTPS probe through the inherited proxy returned200. The exact runtime auth-path failure is unresolved; no authentication readiness claim is warranted.
groups.confidence: high on observed failure/probe; root cause unresolved
groups.recommended_fix: Diagnose the auth library/runtime proxy path with unchanged implementation and documented diagnostic purpose before online identity/admission tests.

groups.finding: The six synthetic tick-query samples per baseline are short, zero-client mob smoke measurements. They do not establish sustained TPS, generator utilization or capacity. Per-node CPU/RAM/network and raw main-thread instrumentation are incomplete.
groups.confidence: high: frozen workload and raw samples
groups.recommended_fix: Add full resource samplers and raw timing metrics, real activity replay, 10min warmup/30min steady/ramp-down and separate mass-disconnect scenarios. Preserve the approved thresholds.

ledger.scope: Opaque control-plane bytes; durable transitions/CAS/idempotency, race, abrupt JVM halt at7 phases, outbox persistence/backpressure. Not Minecraft state conservation.

transport.scope: Real loopback mTLS/gRPC; authenticated roles, wrong peer/cluster rejection, version/deadline rejection, plaintext/no-certificate rejection and persisted peer replay. Not multi-PC performance.

emma_smp_unit.scope: Existing server unit suite; no skipped/failed tests. Not cross-server operation coverage.

positive_evidence.real_stack: Three real Fabric26.2 servers booted with source-built EndInv1.4.5, MTMC/emma-smp, pinned Fabric API/Lithium/ServerCore. Each selftest reported120 successful cross-level loads,0 failed and120 handed-off tickets. All three saved worlds and stopped.
positive_evidence.endinv_snapshot: Actual EndInv codec roundtrip succeeded on empty data only; populated state and player selections were not exercised.
positive_evidence.log_diagnostics: Five logged foreign-ticket diagnostics per server originated from ParallelLevelTicker.selfTest deliberately invoking cross-level access; they were handled/countable. They must be distinguished from the separate auth error, not suppressed indiscriminately.

capacity.reason: No real active-player workload or multi-PC performance run; no inference from joins or synthetic samples. A hot whole dimension retains its single owner budget.

post_run_probe.purpose: Determine whether the public-key endpoint is generally unreachable through the configured HTTP proxy
post_run_probe.conclusion: Endpoint reachable through proxy; runtime failure still requires diagnosis
